subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md content into model context, and what authority and isolation boundary should that content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing slash-invoked skills from advisory model text to guaranteed context changes prompt authority for potentially untrusted skill content.

options.title: Define guarded core injection
options.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after maintainers define delimiters, precedence, compatibility behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Prefer a SkillInput/tool route
options.body: Route explicit skill slash commands through a dedicated SkillInput or Skill-style tool contract instead of bespoke hidden prompt injection.

options.title: Keep advisory routing
options.body: Document the current model-routed behavior as intentional and direct deterministic workflows to `command-dispatch: tool`.

recommendation.title: Define guarded core injection
recommendation.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after maintainers define delimiters, precedence, compatibility behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for user-invocable skill commands and is the best available owner for the product/security boundary choice.
